# Deploying HIMKO Biology App

## Quick Deploy Options

### Option 1: Netlify (Recommended - Free)
1. Go to https://app.netlify.com/drop
2. Drag and drop the `himko-biology` folder
3. Wait for deployment
4. Get your shareable URL

### Option 2: Vercel
1. Go to https://vercel.com/drop
2. Drag and drop the `himko-biology` folder
3. Get your shareable URL

### Option 3: GitHub Pages
1. Create a new repository on GitHub
2. Upload all files from `himko-biology` folder
3. Go to Settings → Pages
4. Select "main" branch and save

## Files in this folder
- index.html - Main app
- index-ios.html - iOS version
- app.js - Biology questions
- style.css - Styling
- manifest.json - PWA config
- service-worker.js - Offline support
- netlify.toml - Netlify config
- _redirects - URL routing

## Share with your daughter
Once deployed, share the URL with her and she can access it from any country!
